name: Aspect Rose
description: Avalanche danger by slope direction and elevation: eight aspects by three elevation rings on a five-step scale, each cell numbered, with its key beside it.

props.name: levels
props.description: Danger from 1 to 5, one array per aspect clockwise from north, with one value per elevation band in the order of bands.

props.name: bands
props.description: Elevation bands from the centre outward. Bulletins draw the mountain from above, so the highest band sits in the centre.

props.name: elevations
props.description: Height range for each band, shown in the key, e.g. "2,400 m+".

props.name: levelNames
props.description: Names of the five levels, lowest first.

props.name: size
props.description: Largest rose diameter in pixels, labels included. It shrinks to fit the card.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the key of levels and elevation bands beside the rose, or under it when the card is narrow.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the rose shows, for screen readers. Generated from the levels when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: value
props.description: The headline. Defaults to the name of the highest level.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the headline. Defaults to the highest level out of five.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the line under the rose that reads out the hovered or focused cell.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, action and every other prop of a div.
